**Done**

- [ ] Emits domain events and correlated telemetry
- [ ] Documented: API reference, CLI help, changelog line
- [ ] Degrades correctly offline (P2); denies correctly without permission (P8)
- [ ] Inside the performance and accessibility budgets (P10)
- [ ] ADR exists if a technology choice changed
